question: What bodily freedoms are attributed to one who attains the state produced by the wheel configuration?
premises: One becomes freed from wrinkles and grey hair.
One becomes devoid of all disease.
These are presented as results of the preceding configuration.
inference: Attainment of that state brings freedom from wrinkles and grey hair and freedom from all disease.
uncertainties: This verse states the result but does not repeat the agent explicitly.
plain_english: Freed from wrinkles and grey hair, and devoid of all disease.
